title: Autocharge - Charger continued to charge after StopTransaction
description:
We are in a proof of concept with Uno-X.
In December there was an incident where a charging session was started with AutoCharge.
StopTransaction was sent to the backend after approx.. 1 minute, whoever the charger did not stop charging.
The charger stopped after 23 minuts.
I have tried to look in the logs, and I cannot find any reason why this happened.
In the start of the session I can see that some one is aborting a credit card transaction just before the StopTransaction.
We need to give Uno-X an explanation.
The charger was running FW4 at the time. It have now been updated to FW6.
If we can answer that the bug have been fixed in FW6, then this is sufficient.
